summary: Iteration 24: Tested 3 admin UI/UX changes (sidebar layout fix, logo upload, maintenance mode). Both backend (5/5 pytest) and frontend (all UI flows) tests PASSED. Sidebar shows all 12 nav items with logout in normal flex flow (no overlap). General tab in AdminSettings renders Logo del sitio + Modo mantenimiento sections. Maintenance mode correctly blocks / while leaving /admin and /pst accessible. Backend persists site_logo_url and maintenance_mode via PUT /api/settings.

issues: 2 console 404 errors observed on General tab load - likely favicon/asset requests, not blocking functionality. Non-critical.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettings.jsx (413 lines) is approaching the 700 line threshold - consider splitting each tab into its own component for maintainability.
SiteSettingsContext refetches settings only once at mount; consider exposing a refresh function so that after admin saves changes (logo/maintenance), the context updates without a page reload.
FALLBACK_LOGO in SiteSettingsContext is hardcoded to an external emergentagent URL - fine as fallback but consider moving to env or bundling locally to avoid external dependency.
seed_data_creation: None - tests use PUT/GET only and cleanup at end
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 24 verified: sidebar flex layout, 12 nav items + logout no overlap, 7 settings tabs, logo upload UI, maintenance toggle, MaintenanceGate only wraps public routes (admin/pst untouched), backend site_logo_url + maintenance_mode persistence. Test file test_settings_maintenance.py includes auth-required PUT check and cleanup.
